prompt: A cinematic film still captures a bustling shipyard dock under overcast skies. On the far left, a worker in a yellow hard hat stands firmly beside a rusted anchor chain, his posture rigid with anticipation. In the center foreground, a large blue cargo crate sits heavily on the wet concrete, its metal corners chipped and worn from travel. To the right of the crate, a woman in a green raincoat points decisively toward the horizon, her arm extended with urgency. Next to her, a man in a brown leather jacket looks intently at the same distant point, his expression serious and focused. Behind them, a tall crane operator in an orange vest leans out of the cab window, watching the scene below with mild curiosity. Near the water's edge on the left, a stray black cat crouches low on a wooden pallet, its eyes fixed on a seagull perched precariously on a nearby railing. The seagull ruffles its white feathers against the damp wind. The worker in the yellow hard hat is handing a rolled-up blueprint to the woman in the green raincoat, their fingers briefly touching as the exchange occurs. The man in the brown leather jacket is sitting on the edge of the blue cargo crate, his legs dangling slightly above the ground. There is no visible text or signage on any of the containers or machinery.
